Trechos que o modelo apontou como contra: Passages the model flagged as contradiction, repetition or wrong meaning, and what was changed.
Cenas em que o polimento saiu do texto (: Scenes where polishing strayed from the text (shrank, grew, brought in people who were not in the scene). The final chapter uses their draft.
O que este capítulo acrescentou ou mudou: What this chapter added to or changed in the story memory, and what was rejected.
Itens obrigatórios distribuídos pelas ce: Required items assigned to scenes, and forbidden names (file checklist.json, which you can edit).

Vai no fim do prompt de cada cena em que: It goes at the end of the prompt of each scene the character is in (the protagonist, in every scene). Without it, the sheet is used.
It goes at the end of the prompt of each scene the character is in. Without it, the sheet is used.
Vai para o prompt da cena que cita o loc: It goes into the prompt of the scene that mentions the place (along with the place that contains it), or of every scene, if marked. End with a "Never: …" sentence listing what is not there, so the model does not invent it.
Tradução para ler. O modelo continua len: Translation for reading. The model keeps reading the memory in the story language; make fixes there, in the fields on screen.
Mostra a memória traduzida para o idioma: Shows the memory translated into the interface language, read only
É o que o modelo lembra da história, no: This is what the model remembers about the story, in the story language (translating the memory every chapter changed names and meanings). The fields are updated after each chapter; you can fix them by hand.

Qual é o título da história?: What is the title of the story?
De onde vem o mundo da história?: Where does the story's world come from?
Mundo original, criado para esta fic: Original world, created for this fic
Um universo só, vários universos conecta: A single universe, several connected universes, or one universe in different timelines.
Hub central (estação, cidade, mercado en: Central hub (station, city, market between worlds)
Simulação ou jogo em que os mundos são f: Simulation or game where the worlds are stages
Organização que administra o multiverso: An organization that runs the multiverse
A lista de universos é fechada?: Is the list of universes closed?
Fechada: só os universos listados existe: Closed: only the listed universes exist, and no outside character may appear.
Aberta: novos universos podem entrar dur: Open: new universes may join during the story
Quais universos entram na história?: Which universes are in the story?
Escolha do catálogo ou cadastre um unive: Pick from the catalog or add a new universe. Each has a role, a wiki and allowed characters. A multiverse needs at least 2; other structures, 1.
Qual é o ponto de divergência das linhas: What is the divergence point of the timelines?
O evento a partir do qual as linhas se s: The event from which the timelines split.
Quanto do cânone original a história res: How much of the original canon does the story respect?
Cânone estrito: nada contradiz as obras: Strict canon: nothing contradicts the works
Homenagem livre: só nomes e ideias: Loose homage: only names and ideas
Em que época do cânone a história começa: When in the canon does the story start?
Ex.: 'dez anos antes da série', 'ano 180: E.g. 'ten years before the series', 'year 1804', 'present day'.
Qual é o sistema de poder dominante?: What is the dominant power system?
Que regras de jogo o sistema tem?: Which game rules does the system have?
Como poderes de universos diferentes con: How do powers from different universes coexist?
Só aparece quando há mais de um mundo ou: Only shown when there is more than one world or franchise.
Todos igualados por uma regra do mundo (: Everyone equalized by a world rule (e.g. base level)
Depende do lugar ou do modo (ex.: só em: Depends on the place or mode (e.g. only in games, only with consent)
Name, origin and age. At least one.
Quem são os personagens de apoio princip: Who are the main supporting characters?
Que tipo de antagonismo a história tem?: What kind of antagonism does the story have?
Qual o ponto de vista?: What is the point of view?
Terceira pessoa limitada a um personagem: Third person limited to one character
Em que idioma a história é escrita?: Which language is the story written in?
Quantos capítulos tem a primeira tempora: How many chapters does the first season have?
Uma obra e o que imitar dela (ritmo, lev: A work and what to imitate from it (pace, lightness, tone). Do not copy passages.
Retratos (só para você; o modelo não lê: Portraits (for you only; the model does not read images):
Aparece no cartão do projeto e na primei: Shown on the project card and as the first page of the EPUB. 2:3 ratio (e.g. 400 × 600, Royal Road's).
